A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same 31-page work, including Appendices A–D. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison establish matching scientific content throughout. Differences are confined to the first-page arXiv stamp and PDF metadata.

before.justification: v1 reports original ADNI/AIBL MRI-forecasting experiments in Section 5, including benchmark comparisons and ablations, with additional quantitative and qualitative results in Appendices C–D.

after.justification: v2 retains the original forecasting results in Table 1, ablations in Tables 2–11, and longitudinal, regional, gradient, and qualitative analyses.

M1.justification: The latent residual tokenizer, finite scalar quantization, conditioned autoregressive generator, training objectives, and inference procedure are identical in Section 4 and Algorithms 1–2.

E1.justification: Both versions use ADNI and AIBL for longitudinal brain MRI forecasting, with the same patient population and prediction horizons up to 48 months.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains CycleGAN, Palette, I2I-DiT, BrLP, VQGAN, RQ-Transformer, and NeuroAR. Comparator membership in the ablations and qualitative comparisons is also unchanged.

E3.justification: Both retain 3,981 scan pairs with 1,140 test pairs, the same preprocessing and resolution, evaluation metrics, frozen-classifier protocol, training settings, and single-forecast evaluation procedure.

E4.justification: Prediction-target, quantizer, FSQ-grid, and generator ablations are identical. Longitudinal and regional analyses, gradient visualizations, and qualitative comparisons are also unchanged, including Appendices C–D.

E5.justification: Section 5.2 retains the same Wilcoxon signed-rank testing and p < 0.05 statement. There are no changes to repeated-run information, seed disclosure, or uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: Numerical and qualitative results match throughout. For example, Table 1 reports Latent Drift Diff-SSIM of 0.8204 and accuracy of 88.33 in both versions; appendix ablation scores are likewise identical.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, assumptions, Theorems 1–4, Corollary 1, Proposition 1, and Appendix A proofs are unchanged.

C1.justification: Both make identical claims about identity collapse, the continuous interpolation trap, latent drift prediction, FSQ noise suppression, and improved patient-specific forecasting.

C2.justification: Mechanistic interpretations and limitations are identical, including possible under-representation of rapidly changing regions and validation restricted to registered, downsampled ADNI/AIBL data.

D1.justification: Appendix B retains the same preprocessing instructions, hardware, optimizers, training schedules, sampling temperature, and pseudocode. The project-page link and resource-access information are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 6, research positioning, and all 63 cited references are unchanged.

P1.justification: The arXiv stamp changes from v1, 9 Jul 2026 to v2, 2 Sep 2026. PDF author metadata corrects 'Shujun Wan' to 'Shujun Wang'; both printed author lists already say 'Wang'. Manuscript wording and section structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: The first-page vertical arXiv stamp is repositioned and its rendering changes. Figures, tables, captions, and manuscript layout are identical; pages 2–31 render identically.

improvement.justification: The scientific argument, experiments, proofs, reproducibility details, and appendices are unchanged. The updated arXiv stamp and corrected author metadata provide administrative refinements without a meaningful change in the paper's overall quality.
